configuration.primary_vs_alternative: 1+2 versus 3; no adoption or electrical qualification
configuration.preferred_lv15_exploration: lv15_core; avoid assuming CP/dividers must also run at 1.5 V

hv18.description: 3.3 V analog input -> thick-oxide regulator -> quiet 1.8 V island
hv18.status: proposed_interface_range; not a promise of 5.5 V compatibility

bypass18.description: Qualified external 1.8 V -> isolated bypass -> same quiet island
bypass18.status: baseline DC range retained; ripple/PSD and reverse-blocking interface unqualified

lv15.description: 1.8 V input -> low-dropout regulator -> quiet 1.5 V island
lv15.status: unmeasured low-voltage architecture; keep dividers/TX/RX on host 1.8 V initially

lv15_core.description: 1.8 V -> quiet 1.5 V VCO only; retain CP/LF and dividers at host 1.8 V
lv15_core.status: preferred scope of LV exploration; mixed-supply LF reference, local bias, code drive and clock interface unresolved

vco_projection.method: same-code bracketed roots; linear supply extension is a hypothesis, never acceptance

nominal_existing_nodes.condition: TT 1.8 V 27 C, Rtt, K6, Vctrl=1.195 V, real bias, four buffers/30 fF per leg
nominal_existing_nodes.limit: Rigid node shift is a headroom illustration; not a 1.5 V operating point or VDS-VDSAT check

limitations: No LDO circuit, transistor sizing, output capacitance, PSRR or stability is qualified
4/6/10 mA are load budgets; Iq, startup and reverse-blocking losses excluded
1.5 V CP upper edge, monitor window and VCO roots are planning proxies outside the measured supply range
Charge-bound C values assume the regulator supplies none of the additional current for the stated delay; not selected Cout
VCO current can stay similar at lower voltage, but full PVT headroom, cap-bank switch loss and noise remain unknown
bands_scope: CP/monitor upper proxies apply only if CP/monitor rails are also lowered; not lv15_core with CP retained at 1.8 V
